title.en: Fable 1 — The Oak and the Reed

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: A big oak laughed at the reed.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר לו: אתה חלש ואתה מתכופף.
sentences.en: He said to him: you are weak and you bend.

sentences.ar: הקנה אמר: אני מתכופף ואני נשאר.
sentences.en: The reed said: I bend and I stay.
At night a strong storm came.
The oak fell and the reed stayed.
The one who bends does not break.
